oakA.notes: Lumpy round crown, no windswept rag; short trunk with root flare sits on ground. Lit upper-left reads as volume. Outline/shade steps match the house at same scale (trees_v3_kits_2x row 3 vs row 1).

oakB.notes: Left edge now stepped/irregular, no doubled rim visible (v3_pv_oakB). Wider, flatter crown than oakA, but at kit scale oakA/oakB read as near-same round oak (minor).

bushC.notes: Ovoid/conical lumpy bush, distinct from others; reads close to a small juniper (minor).

bushD.notes: No longer a rectangle; lumpy mound with stepped top and sides (v3_pv_bushD).

bushE.notes: Low wide mound; no lollipop stem, no lattice texture (v3_pv_bushE). Flat base is the ground line, acceptable.

canopy.notes: canopy_cmp after: mass reads as mixed forest, seams not visible. Bottom fringe shows a run of evenly spaced trunks at ~y795 (2x), similar to before. v3_preview_4x canopy fill strip shows a regular ~16px repeat of identical blobs with the same lime highlight position; mostly hidden under trees in real use.

forest_crop.notes: RIGHT, lower-left block (approx x660-880, y260-360): three identical light-palette oak crowns side by side, tops aligned on one horizontal line, three identical trunks at equal spacing on the same row. Reads as an orchard row, the exact round-1/2 failure. Old version had the same slots but varied crowns so it read less gridded. Cause is likely the same variant/palette repeated in adjacent slots (placement/variant selection), not the single design. Dark backdrop patch has straight top/right edges in both before and after (pre-existing).

blocking_issues: forest_crop.png RIGHT x~660-880 y~260-360: three copy-identical oak crowns + three evenly spaced trunks in one row -> orchard-row look persists. Vary variant/palette/size and stagger trunk y or hide trunks behind the next row.
minor: oakA and oakB read nearly identical at kit scale (trees_v3_kits_2x row 3, the two big oaks).
